form.title: Your health and exposure history
form.intro: These questions take about 90 seconds. They help us understand what may have affected your skin over the years. Your answers are combined with your photo, but are shown separately.
validation.exceeds_age: This cannot be more than your age.
age_years.label: How old are you?
fire_pot_use.label: Do you use a fire-pot or portable heater held close to the body (kangri, sigri, angithi, bukhari)?
fire_pot_use.help: These are clay or metal pots with hot coals that people keep under clothing or on the lap in cold weather.
fire_pot_use.option.past: I used to, but not now
fire_pot_years.label: For how many years in total have you used it?
fire_pot_years.help: Count all winters together. Enter 0 if you have never used one.
has_burn_scar.label: Do you have an old burn scar or a wound that never fully healed?
has_burn_scar.help: Include burns from fire, hot liquids or chemicals.
burn_scar_age_years.label: How many years ago did the burn or wound happen?
burn_scar_nonhealing_ulcer.label: Is there a sore, ulcer or new lump in the scar that is not healing?
burn_scar_nonhealing_ulcer.help: For example a wound that keeps opening, bleeds easily or has grown recently.
water_source.label: What is your main source of drinking water at home?
water_source.help: Choose the one you use most often.
district.label: Which district do you live in?
district.help: Your home district, not where you work.
state.label: Which state do you live in?
state.help: Optional, but it helps us find the correct district.
years_at_water_source.label: For how many years have you been drinking this water?
years_at_water_source.help: Or living in this district, if you are not sure.
outdoor_hours_per_day.label: On an average day, how many hours do you spend working outdoors?
outdoor_hours_per_day.help: For example farming, construction, fishing, vending or driving. Enter 0 if you mostly work indoors.
outdoor_work_years.label: For how many years have you worked outdoors?
outdoor_work_years.help: Enter 0 if you have never worked outdoors.
sun_protection.label: When outdoors, do you cover your head and skin or use sunscreen?
sun_protection.help: A hat, turban, cloth, long sleeves or sunscreen all count.
family_history_skin_cancer.label: Has a parent, brother, sister or child ever had skin cancer?
family_history_skin_cancer.help: Answer No if you are not sure.
tobacco_use.label: Do you use tobacco?
tobacco_use.help: Include cigarettes, bidi, hookah, chewing tobacco, gutka or khaini.
